Support level: Supported hypothesis

[REL029, REL034, REL043, POS003, POS002, DIR016, DIR017, LAG027, LAG033]

Other differences: A08's sharply reduced participation, with A47 now proceeding directly to A48, indicates the activity is skipped in most later cases; it still occurs in about 19 in 100 traces, so it became optional rather than absent. A02, A06 and A10 occur in about three times as many traces. Routing around A01/A07/A09 also shifted mildly (A01 less often to A07, about 46 → 21 in 100; A09 more often to A07, about 23 → 48 in 100). These differences are not part of the main hypothesis. [OCC003, DIR019, LAG034, OCC001, OCC002, OCC004, DIR001, DIR004]
